desc.en: Bibi Zainab (s) was the daughter of Imam Ali (a) and Bibi Zahra (s). She was born in Medina on 1st Shaban in the year 6H. and she died in the year 62H. When she was born, the Holy Prophet (s) gave her the name of ‘Zainab’ by the order of Allah (swt). Bibi Zainab (s) was a very clever, intelligent and pious lady. She devoted her whole life in spreading and saving Islam. She used to teach Qur’an with the meanings to the ladies of Kufa.
desc.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

desc.en: In the year 60H she went with Imam Husain (a) to Karbala. On every occasion in Karbala, Imam Husain (a) used to take the advice of Bibi Zainab (s) On the day of Ashura, her two sons, Ibrahim and Aun Muhammad sacrificed their lives for the sake of Islam. On the 11th Muharram, 60H. they were taken captives and marched through the towns of Kufa and Shaam.

For one year they stayed captives in Damascus. Bibi Zainab (s) faced Yazid after the Tragedy of Karbala and told him of the wrongs he had done. She also gave very good sermons whenever she got a chance, she therefore enabled the people to know the principles and practices of Islam and the wrong and merciless killings of the followers of Imam Husain (a) in Karbala by Yazid and his army. Due to her honesty, bravery and truthfulness, Islam spread through Shaam.

When they were released from prison, she, along with the rest of the members of Ahlul Bayt went to Medina. Even in Medina, she continued preaching. Islam spread rapidly. The governor of Medina became very frightened and wrote to Yazid that Bibi Zainab (s) was in Medina and was spreading Islam quickly and that she would break his empire. Yazid gave orders that Bibi Zainab (s) should leave Medina and settle in a village outside Medina. Later on, from there she was sent to a town called Misr which is in Egypt.

She continued spreading Islam there as well. Yazid became very scared so he once again ordered that she be taken prisoner and brought to Shaam. When she arrived at a small village on the boundary of Shaam, she remembered where Imam Husain (s) head had been kept on a farm under a tree. When she found the tree, she started crying.

A man of Shaam, who was a follower and friend of Yazid, saw her and hit her with a spade on her head. She collapsed and died. Imam Zainul Abedeen (s) buried her there. That is how this small town came to be known as As-Sayyid Zainab. According to historians, Bibi Zainab (s)’s husband, Abdullah Ibne Ja’far’e Tayyar was a very rich man. He bought the surrounding land and made the Rauza especially in the name of Bibi Zainab (s).

In the town of Misr in Egypt, there is another Ziyarat of Bibi Zainab (s) and the place is known as Masjid-e-Zainabia. This Bibi Zainab is the daughter of Yahya, Yahya binte Zayed, Zayed Binte Zainul Abedin (a). She is the great granddaughter of our 4th Imam (a) The Bohoras go to Cairo to the Ziyarat of this Bibi Zainab.
